🚀 proxmox-manager | Shell
🎯 Primary Use Case: To provide a convenient and efficient command-line interface for managing Proxmox VE virtual machines and containers, especially for users who prefer TUI environments or need a lightweight, dependency-free solution.
✨ Key Features: • Single-file Bash TUI • No external dependencies • VM/CT listing and status • Start/stop/restart functionality • Snapshot management
📖 Summary: Proxmox Manager is a single-file Bash script that provides a Text-based User Interface (TUI) for managing Proxmox Virtual Machines (VMs) and Containers (CTs). It offers essential management functions without external dependencies, focusing on ease of use and direct interaction with Proxmox VE.
